column1: # alloclint same-site renames (main 2026-10-14T22:10:42Z ruling on planir's ask; ratchet.py base / check, LOWER-A-ROW.md).
# A row lets the SAME allocation site change detector item: the ledger's new item may rise by `count` at that site when the old
# item falls by at least as much, the file's total debt does not rise, and the site is provably the same (base: the tree's
# `line` is a changed line whose removed twin in the same change block is the line with the new item's name spelled as the
# old one's; S1: the new item's finding sits on `line`). Never a new site, never one moved to another function. One row per
# use, added by the commit that makes the change; rows stay as the record. line = the line in the tree that adds the row.
